desc: Two of the most respected names in the shooting sports industry - Ruger and Dead Air Silencers have joined forces to introduce an entirely new class of suppressors: the Ruger RXD Series. This bold new line isn't a rebrand or a re-skin - it's a ground-up innovation built to complement Ruger's renowned firearm platforms with uncompromising performance, design, and maintainability. Ruger has collaborated with Dead Air to deliver a new standard in rimfire performance: the RXD22Ti. This innovative suppressor is comprised of a Titanium tube, a 3D printed PVD coated single-piece Triskelion core, titanium retaining cap and the XRF muzzle brake specially designed to enhance performance and capture lead.
